name: copy_memory_block_aligned
description: Copies a block of bytes between two buffers. It first aligns the destination, then moves long words in unrolled groups and finishes the remaining bytes one at a time.

name: copy_header_then_call
description: When the buffer pointer is non-null, copies sixteen long words from a fixed offset of a shared structure into it, then calls a stored routine.

name: open_use_close_graphics_intuition
description: Opens the graphics and intuition libraries, sets a flag in a display structure, frees the raster and remakes the display, then closes both libraries.

name: create_device_task_and_port
description: Allocates a device structure, stores the caller's data in it, then sets up its command port and signal and registers it with the system through library calls that add the device and task.

name: queue_request_with_sequence_number
description: If the input is zero and the device's active count is non-zero, increments the count and a sequence number, stores the sequence number in a request block and sets a fixed pair of timing words in it. It then calls routines.

name: open_audio_device_request
description: Opens the audio device when no requests are active, fills in an I/O request block with a command code, a data pointer and a length, and calls library routines to set it up.

name: create_message_port_request
description: Fills in a message block with a command code, a data pointer and a size, then calls a library allocation. On failure it sets an error byte and marks the request invalid; on success it records the returned pointer and updates the state count.

name: record_event_and_increment_counter
description: Stores its input value in a device record, increments a counter in the record and copies it into a second record. It then writes fixed timing words and a byte into the second record and clears a flag bit in the first.

name: mark_status_invalid
description: Stores its byte argument in a status field and sets a 32-bit field to minus one.

name: check_device_pending_state
description: Clears a bit in a record's status byte, then checks a device flag and a pending pointer. It stores a status code and calls a routine when nothing is pending, otherwise it moves on to a further check.

name: update_status_on_request_match
description: When a request identifier matches and the device is not suspended, copies a changed status value into the record and writes the interrupt enable register.

name: copy_status_nibbles_to_record
description: When the device is not suspended and the status differs, stores the status byte in the record together with its low nibble, then writes the interrupt enable register.

name: copy_byte_and_split_nibbles
description: Copies a status byte from one structure to another, stores its low and high nibbles in two further bytes, clears a flag byte in the destination and calls one routine.

name: process_device_list_entries
description: Loops over a linked list of device entries, updating a counter in each and adjusting shared words, and writes the interrupt enable register as it goes.

name: decrement_counter_and_mask_interrupts
description: Decrements a counter byte in the device record and, on underflow, sets a shared word. It then writes the interrupt enable register.

name: dispatch_to_matching_list_entries
description: Walks a linked list of entries, calls a routine for each entry whose identifier matches the request identifier, and returns zero.

name: decrement_counter_and_close_device
description: Decrements a counter in the device record and, when it reaches zero, frees a memory block and closes the device. It returns the close status, and an optional routine runs when a flag is set.

name: dispatch_request_by_type_index
description: Uses a field value between one and eight to choose a routine from a jump table. Any other value sets an error status byte and calls a routine instead.

name: remove_node_and_free_block
description: When a link field is zero, removes a node from its list and calls library routines to free its memory. Otherwise it takes an alternative path.

name: unlink_free_node_field
description: Calls a list operation, unlinks a node from its list, frees the node's memory through the system and returns a value stored in the node.

name: set_request_state_and_branch
description: Sets a request state byte to a fixed value and toggles flag bits in the record, then branches on the request type and calls library and handler routines.

name: set_request_seven_signal
description: Clears a flag bit in a structure, sets the request type field to seven and a status bit in the device record, sends a signal through the library, then clears a byte in the second structure and calls a routine.

name: set_request_six_signal
description: Sets a flag bit in a structure, marks the request type as six and sets a status bit in the device record, calls a library routine, then clears a byte in the second structure and calls a routine.

name: bracket_calls_with_busy_flag
description: Sets bit seven of a status byte, calls two routines, then clears the same bit so both calls run with the flag held.

name: bracket_call_clear_byte
description: Sets bit seven of a status byte, calls a routine, clears the bit and a byte in the second structure, then calls a further routine.

name: walk_list_and_signal_completion
description: Calls one routine when a field in the record is non-zero, then sets a shared word, increments a counter byte and walks a linked list of entries.

name: decrement_shared_counter_and_reset
description: Decrements a counter byte in the shared area and, when its previous value was below one, sets a shared word to a fixed value.

name: mark_matching_entry_and_count
description: Sets a shared word and increments a shared counter byte. When the record is the device's current entry, it sets a flag bit in the record and calls two routines.

name: scan_list_and_release_count
description: Walks a linked list to its end, then decrements a counter byte and sets a shared word to a fixed value when the counter was not positive.

name: unlink_entry_and_decrement_count
description: Unlinks a node from its list, sets the node's state byte to a fixed value, decrements a counter byte and calls a routine. It resets a shared word when the count was not positive.

name: decrement_device_count_and_reset
description: Decrements a counter byte in the device record and sets a shared word when the previous value was less than one.

name: set_error_state_and_report
description: Stores an error state code in a record and calls one routine.

name: clear_state_and_call_routine
description: Clears the state byte of a record and calls one routine.

name: clear_flag_and_call_library
description: Clears a flag bit in one structure and a state byte in another, then calls a library routine.

name: store_request_copy_fields
description: Stores a request pointer in a device record and calls a routine. When that routine returns zero, it copies a status byte from the request into the record and continues the update.

name: store_bounded_position_value
description: When the argument is below a fixed limit, stores it as a position in the record, then updates dependent fields from a second field and calls routines.

name: store_bounded_height_value
description: When the argument is below a fixed limit, stores it as a height in the record, then updates dependent fields from a mode field.

name: store_mode_dependent_field
description: Stores its argument in a record field, then reads a mode value and updates a dependent field only for the first two modes.

name: store_range_checked_timing_value
description: Stores its argument in a record field, then compares a second field against a fixed range before updating a dependent value.

name: store_bounded_rate_value
description: When the argument is below a fixed limit, stores it in a record field and updates a dependent field from a second field.

name: store_threshold_result_pointer
description: When the argument exceeds sixty-four, calls a routine and stores its result in a record slot, then updates dependent fields.

name: adjust_task_priority_and_free
description: Finds the current task, sets its priority and frees a memory block through system calls, branching on a result flag.

name: copy_field_and_set_state
description: Copies a long value from one field of the record to another, stores a state byte and calls one routine.

name: clear_long_field_state
description: Clears a long field of the record, stores a state byte and calls one routine.

name: scan_buffer_backward_for_byte
description: Scans a buffer backwards from a stored end offset, comparing bytes against a stored value until it finds a match, and calls routines along the way.

name: scan_buffer_for_matching_entry
description: Computes a starting index from a stored length, then scans a byte buffer comparing each byte with a stored value until the match condition holds.

name: shift_and_clear_counter_word
description: Stores a masked half of a stored long value in a 16-bit field, clears the long value and repeats while a flag is set.

name: reset_record_and_allocate_buffers
description: Clears state bytes and fields in two records, then calls library routines that allocate and prepare buffers from a shared table.

name: allocate_buffer_or_flag_failure
description: Stores a byte from the argument in a record, then calls a library allocation. A failed allocation stores an error status, otherwise initialisation continues.

name: setup_speech_io_request
description: Stores a request block pointer, sets its command code and data pointer for the speech device, and calls library routines that find the current task and allocate a signal.

name: allocate_request_block_or_fail
description: Stores a byte in a record, then allocates a block through the system. A null result returns a failure code, otherwise the new pointer is stored in the record.

name: copy_word_table_to_buffer
description: Stores a pointer in a shared variable and copies a 34-word table from a shared area into a buffer, writing each word twice per iteration and repeating for a count taken from a byte in the record.

name: send_command_nine_request
description: Stores a byte from the record in a request block, sets its command field to nine and sends it with a library call.

name: perform_io_and_release_resources
description: Stores a byte and a word in a record, calls a library I/O routine and frees the request memory when a buffer is present. It then releases the signal through a library call.

name: parse_text_into_entry_tables
description: Reads characters from an input text while advancing a pointer and a counter, writing entries into record tables. It returns the input value when the counter is not positive.

name: initialise_entry_tables_and_parse
description: Clears the first table slot and sets up two further record tables, then parses the input text into them.

name: dispatch_command_code_ranges
description: Compares an input code against a set of ascending ranges and dispatches to the matching branch, which calls routines to process the value.

name: lookup_code_in_range_table
description: Checks an input value against an upper limit, looks up a bit in a flag table for that value and branches on the result, calling routines along the way.

name: decode_bit_table_entry
description: Advances an input pointer by an offset, extracts a character and a mask from the input, and looks up a bit table entry to choose the next step, calling routines for each branch.

name: set_output_flag_code_five
description: Sets a byte in an output table when the input code equals five. Other codes pass control to the following routine.

name: handle_phoneme_code_six
description: Passes control on unless the input code equals six, in which case it handles that code by calling routines.

name: update_phoneme_output_entry
description: Reads an input code and a stored value, updates an output table entry when the conditions hold and calls two routines.

name: check_remaining_input_length
description: Compares the remaining input length against a stored limit and branches to the matching phoneme handling step.

name: empty_routine
description: Returns immediately, with no observable operation.

name: lookup_phoneme_table_entry
description: Reads a byte at the current input position. A zero byte moves the position back by one, while a non-zero byte is used to look up a table entry.

name: write_phoneme_entry_if_unflagged
description: Looks up a table entry and, when its flag bit is clear and at least four input positions remain, writes four and zero into two output tables.

name: store_output_length_word
description: Stores a word argument in a record field.

name: emit_output_until_marker
description: Walks a buffer of output bytes, copying values into the output table until an end marker is reached, calling two routines along the way. Its call list also includes an empty routine.

name: copy_text_with_flag_bits
description: Copies bytes from one buffer to another and sets bit four of an earlier output byte when a mask test passes and the character matches the required value.

name: set_flag_zero_digit_entries
description: Copies input bytes to output and sets bit four of a preceding output byte when a table entry's flag bits are set and the character two places back is the digit zero.

name: build_phoneme_index_tables
description: Initialises a counter and two tables at fixed offsets of a record, then loops filling table entries from index values.

name: compute_midpoint_phoneme_code
description: Iterates over input positions, computing a midpoint index from two bounds and setting an output code from table bits on each pass.

name: copy_text_skipping_marker_codes
description: Copies bytes between buffers, skipping two marker codes in the input, and writes output mask bits for each copied byte.

name: advance_past_marker_codes
description: Computes the remaining length and copies output bits while skipping marker codes in the input.

name: stub_return_only_routine
description: The decompiled body is only a return, so the routine has no visible behaviour.

name: run_phoneme_output_pass
description: Calls two routines with pointer and length arguments taken from the input record, then returns a status code.

name: process_phoneme_sequence_pass
description: Processes an input sequence by calling four routines with pointer values taken from the input and output records, each advanced by the position just reached.

name: process_next_phoneme_symbol
description: Reads the next symbol from the input and calls two routines to process it.

name: advance_phoneme_input_pointer
description: Advances the input and output pointers by shared length values and calls one routine.

name: apply_bit_table_phoneme
description: Loops over a buffer of bytes and a word table indexed by a word, updating the word according to bits in each byte. It exits when a specific bit is set or a termination condition is met.

name: bound_stored_word_below_limit
description: Reads a stored word and, when it is below a fixed limit, passes it to a routine as an index. Otherwise it passes the limit itself.

name: shift_phoneme_buffers_and_count
description: Increments a word counter in a record, then shifts bytes backward through three buffers by a computed count, writing a byte and two zero bytes at the new ends.

name: call_seven_routines_return_zero
description: Calls seven routines in turn and returns zero.

name: clear_entry_flags_until_end
description: Clears the flag byte of each eight-byte table entry until the end marker is reached, then sets the flag byte of the final entry to a fixed value.

name: clear_entry_flags_until_char
description: Clears the flag byte of each eight-byte table entry until an entry matches the input character, then sets the flag byte of the final entry to a fixed value.

name: merge_phoneme_buffers
description: Walks three phoneme buffers together until a terminator byte, combining their entries and returning once the terminator is reached.

name: accumulate_phoneme_weights
description: Loops over an input buffer, combining each byte's low six bits with a running value and writing the shifted result back, with a separate path for marker code twenty-three.

name: copy_entries_with_table_flags
description: Loops over table entries and copies the previous output byte when flag bits in each entry are set, otherwise it moves on to the next step.

name: copy_flagged_previous_byte
description: While a table flag bit is set, copies the previous output byte and clears its top bit, then steps through the remaining entries.

name: set_stress_code_from_flags
description: Sets the low bits of an output byte to four or five depending on flag bits in the input, and calls one routine for the remaining cases.

name: set_phoneme_code_by_flag
description: Sets the low bits of an output byte to four or five depending on one flag bit of the input, then advances to the next output position.

name: set_output_bits_and_advance
description: Sets the low bits of the current output byte, advances through the buffers and copies bytes until an end marker.

name: copy_until_terminator_skipping_markers
description: Copies bytes from one buffer to another until a terminator, skipping marker code twenty-three and calling one routine along the way.

name: sum_entries_until_terminator
description: Adds up the masked values of table entries until a terminator byte and stores the sum in a record field.

name: allocate_entry_table
description: Stores a count argument and a byte size of eight times the count plus eight in a record, then allocates the table through the system and stores its pointer on success.

name: store_entry_allocate_if_flagged
description: Stores its argument in a record field and, when a flag byte is set, allocates a block through the system and stores its pointer in the record.

name: encode_phoneme_bytes_into_entry
description: Processes bytes from an input buffer with masked comparisons and writes encoded values into the record's output tables, calling a routine for each item.

name: encode_phoneme_bytes_second_pass
description: Repeats the masked byte encoding over the input buffer with a longer sequence of comparisons, writing encoded values into the output tables and calling one routine.

name: pack_phoneme_bit_fields
description: Combines bit fields from several input bytes into packed output bytes, calling one routine as it goes.

name: copy_phoneme_entries_with_offsets
description: Walks phoneme entries using an offset read from the record and copies bytes between two tables, calling one routine for the remaining entries.

name: lookup_phoneme_bit_table_entry
description: Loops over a table word indexed by a value, testing flag bits and writing combined bytes to the output, with calls to two routines.

name: compute_phoneme_index_and_write
description: Computes an index from a shifted input value and writes bytes to output positions, with one routine call per iteration.

name: emit_packed_phoneme_bytes
description: Combines values from registers into a packed byte, writes it to two output positions and calls three routines.

name: copy_bytes_with_counter_decrement
description: Decrements a counter for each byte and copies bytes from the input to the output until the counter runs out, calling one routine.

name: unpack_phoneme_table_bits
description: Reads bytes from a record table and unpacks them into bit fields in a table of words, calling one routine for each entry.

name: encode_phoneme_pitch_words
description: Loops over an input buffer, combining bytes with values from registers into word-sized entries, and calls two routines to update the output.

name: match_phoneme_terminator_entries
description: Loops over input entries until a terminator byte, combining each entry's bits into the output and calling one routine.

name: combine_phoneme_bits_with_mask
description: Combines bit masks from the input with values held in registers and writes the result to the output, calling one routine.

name: store_phoneme_entry_bits
description: Writes packed bit values from the input into output entries and calls one routine per entry.

name: emit_phoneme_entries_by_flag
description: Walks input bytes and stores entries into an output table according to flag bits, calling two routines.

name: accumulate_phoneme_word_pair
description: Accumulates pairs of input values into a word, stores the word in the output and calls one routine.

name: write_phoneme_word_fields
description: Writes word fields for each input value into the output table and calls one routine.

name: update_phoneme_word_from_input
description: Updates a word in the output from the next input value and calls one routine.

name: update_phoneme_word_pairs
description: Updates pairs of words in the output from input values and calls one routine.

name: adjust_phoneme_word_offset
description: Adds an offset to a word in the output table and calls one routine.

name: copy_phoneme_entry_block
description: Copies bytes between two tables of phoneme entries, adjusting their offsets, and calls one routine.

name: write_byte_to_three_pointers
description: Writes the same byte from a register to the memory locations pointed to by three registers.

name: call_two_routines_in_order
description: Calls two routines in turn and returns.

name: mask_low_nibbles_until_terminator
description: Clears the low four bits of each entry in one table until a terminator byte, then processes a second table.
